checked_decisions.finding: Kei (character_names_021.json: female, Shin Getter-2 pilot) is addressed only with an imperative ('Kei, transform too and counter it!'); no pronoun needed or invented. Correct as drafted.
Game Champ, Queen, and King (Cynthia Lane's and Gainer's locked terms/nicknames, terms_028.json and character_names_021.json) used correctly and consistently.

Barrel (Barrel Orland, confirmed male in glossary.json's char.barrel_orland entry) is defended by an unnamed ally ('Barrel is not lacking!'); the source does not name the defender, so keeping the defender unnamed is correct -- no invented subject.

The YF-19 line ('Not if you can't keep up with this YF-19!') stays name-neutral in the target text, which is correct either way. Flagging for the record: per the orchestrator's Mission 11B cast list, this YF-19 belongs to Faye Rochenante in this scene, not Macross Plus's Isamu Alva Dyson (the batch's original note wrongly implied Isamu); the batch file's note was corrected to remove that misattribution, no change was needed to the visible target text.
Post-mission talk block correctly has no <ab()>/<ed()> at all, matching the source; 'Shin Dragon' matches the locked inherited term (mission_terms_019.json).

Gainer's interlocutor is kept unnamed/gender-neutral throughout, matching the source's lack of a speaker tag; 'she' is used only for Cynthia Lane, whose gender is already locked in character_names_021.json, not inferred from her name. No invented identity.

The <book(56)>Siberian Railway<endbook()> link matches the corresponding encyclopedia entry (encyclopedia_022.json slot 55 / text_id 56); consistent with terms_028.json's ruling that the Siberian Railway's nickname also renders as the full name.

uncertainties.issue: The line translated literally as 'So the malice has arrived!' has no confirmed deeper in-show meaning, ability name, or character epithet found in available King Gainer sources; speaker and referent are not identifiable from surrounding context. Kept as the draft's literal rendering; not fully resolved by this review, but the translation itself is not contradicted by anything found.
